  "caution": "The definition is broad and often used when details are unavailable; it signals an ethical breach by an entity but does not specify the nature of the problem (e.g., data, authorship). Main figure not recommended because the reason is a catch-all for opaque notices.",
  "semantic_rationale": "The reason indicates a journal/publisher/institution found a company/institution/third party violated publishing/research ethics standards. This implicates editorial/peer review governance (standards enforcement) and post-publication transparency (notice of ethical breach). The problem object is article_general due to lack of specificity. Process signals include investigations by journal/publisher, institution, or third party, and a publication policy/sanction. Actor contexts are company/institution, third party, and journal/publisher as the investigating body."
